concerns.text: SC‑001 (MAE reduction ≥ 0.05 eV vs. fingerprint baseline with paired‑test p < 0.05) is not asserted by any task. Add a verification task (e.g., T015) that compares the GNN test‑set MAE to the baseline MAE, checks the ≥ 0.05 eV reduction, and enforces the paired‑test significance threshold.

SC‑002 (feature‑importance significance requires MAE increase ≥ 0.05 eV, p < 0.05, and Cohen’s d ≥ 0.5) lacks a task that computes Cohen’s d and validates the MAE‑increase criterion. Introduce a task (e.g., T016) that extends the ablation result verification to include Cohen’s d and the MAE‑increase threshold.

FR‑018 (primary a priori power analysis before any training) is only addressed by the fallback task T014. Add a dedicated task (e.g., T017) that runs the power analysis on the full intended training set (≥ 20 000 molecules) and aborts the pipeline if power < 0.8.

FR‑020 (verification of QM9 URL and column schema against the primary source) is not represented. Add a task (e.g., T018) that checks the dataset URL, validates the column schema (presence of SMILES and homo) against the original QM9 publication, and aborts on mismatch.

FR‑025 (CI job orchestration with per‑job ≤ 6 h, ≤ 7 GB RAM) has no concrete task. Create a task (e.g., T019) that generates the GitHub Actions workflow, verifies each job’s time and memory limits, and records the orchestration schema for reproducibility.

FR‑026 (Verified Accuracy – title‑token overlap ≥ 0.7 for external citations) is only partially covered by T001 (URL/checksum). Add a verification step (e.g., within T001 or a new task T020) that fetches the cited pages, computes title‑token overlap, and fails the pipeline if the threshold is not met.
